        AND TRIM(survey_finished_at) != ''

# 检查时间戳格式并确定正确的日期转换方法
def determine_timestamp_format():
    """检查时间戳格式，确定正确的SQL转换方法"""
    test_query = """
    SELECT 
        survey_finished_at,
        typeof(survey_finished_at) as type,
        CASE

            WHEN survey_finished_at GLOB '[0-9]*' AND LENGTH(survey_finished_at) = 13 THEN 'unix_milliseconds'
            WHEN survey_finished_at GLOB '*-*-* *:*:*' THEN 'iso_string'
            ELSE 'unknown'
        END as format
    FROM qualtrics__response
    WHERE survey_finished_at IS NOT NULL
    LIMIT 3
    """
    
    try:
        format_df = pd.read_sql_query(test_query, conn)
        print(f"\n时间戳格式检查:")

                return 'unix_milliseconds'

        return 'iso'

# 创建基于时间戳格式的查询
def create_monthly_query(timestamp_fmt='iso'):
    """根据时间戳格式创建月度查询"""
    
    if timestamp_fmt == 'unix_seconds':
        date_expr = "strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(survey_finished_at, 'unixepoch'))"
    elif timestamp_fmt == 'unix_milliseconds':
        date_expr = "strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(survey_finished_at/1000, 'unixepoch'))"
    else:  # iso or auto
        date_expr = "strftime('%Y-%m', survey_finished_at)"
    
    query = f"""
    SELECT 
        {date_expr} as month,
        distribution_channel,
        CAST(AVG(survey_progress) AS REAL) as avg_survey_progress,
        CAST(AVG(duration_in_seconds) AS REAL) as avg_duration_seconds,
        COUNT(*) as response_count
    FROM qualtrics__response
    WHERE survey_finished_at IS NOT NULL 
        AND survey_progress IS NOT NULL 
        AND duration_in_seconds IS NOT NULL
        AND distribution_channel IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(survey_finished_at) != ''
        AND survey_finished_at != 'None'
    GROUP BY month, distribution_channel
    ORDER BY month ASC, distribution_channel ASC
    """
    return query

    query = create_monthly_query(timestamp_format)
